title: Measure of a symmetric difference in a ball equals the L¹ distance of the indicators
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and R ∈ ℝ, and let A, F ⊆ ℝ^N be L^N-null-measurable sets with real-valued indicator functions 1_A and 1_F. Let B_R(0) be the open ball (empty if R ≤ 0) and A Δ F the symmetric difference. Then, in [0, ∞], L^N(B_R(0) ∩ (A Δ F)) = ofReal(∫_{B_R(0)} |1_A(y) − 1_F(y)| dL^N(y)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A F : Set (Rn N)) (R : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet A volume → NullMeasurableSet F volume → volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff A F) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R, |A.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) y - F.indicator (1 : Rn N → ℝ) y|)
